description: This file defines a custom annotation @WithTenantContext used for testing purposes within the Fineract project. It specifies tenant context details such as tenant name and timezone for test setup.

classes.name: WithTenantContext
classes.description: A custom Java annotation for specifying tenant context in tests, including tenant name and timezone ID.

methods.name: tenantName
methods.description: Returns the tenant name with default 'default'.

methods.name: tenantTimeZoneId
methods.description: Returns the timezone ID for the tenant, defaulting to ASIA_KOLKATA_ID.
